text:
I come to watch you pass every day,
+        enchanted little steamer, always far away…
+        Your eyes are two fair-haired captains;
+        your lip a very small red
+        handkerchief waving in a farewell of blood!
+
+
+        I come to watch you pass; until one day,
+        drunk on time and cruelty,
+        enchanted little steamer, always far away,
+        the evening star will set sail!
+        The rigging; treacherous winds; winds
+        of a woman who passed!
+        Your cold captains will give the order;
+        and the one who will have sailed away will be me…!

translation.title: Gunwales of Ice
translation.editorial_note: The distant woman and diminutive steamer remain superimposed; partir shifts from the evening star’s departure to the speaker’s final sailing.
